note: Campaign-runner polarity for cmd/fuzzpinctl -campaign-fixtures. The -replay-fixtures catalog proves the STATIC pins can fail; this one proves the EXECUTED campaign can fail. Every manifest here is synthetic validator input, never a claim artifact.

cases.rationale: The suite's only green case: a replay command that exits 0 twice with an identical normalized outcome REPRODUCES. Without it, every red case below could be produced by a runner that never reports success.
A failing campaign is a failing campaign. The exit code is read from the real process state and printed verbatim, never invented and never rounded to zero.
F005 in the runner: the liveness guard is a wall-clock deadline, and a run that exceeds it is KILLED and FAILS. A killed run must never be reported as a pass.

Two runs whose normalized outcomes differ are not a reproduction, however green each run looked on its own. A replay command nobody ran is a string; a replay command that gives a different answer each time is not a replay.
A command that exits 0 while running nothing is the quietest false green there is.
